description: The rendered ConfirmationAndVerificationStatement body for confirmed answers, over the deployed API. Never reaches the Companies House XML Gateway; every director's personal code is masked in the rendered body before it leaves the route.

dateSigned.description: The date the statement is signed, YYYY-MM-DD

directors.description: One verification statement row per current director

nameMismatchReason.description: Required when the director's register name differs from Companies House's own

lawfulPurposeStatementAccepted.description: The user's confirmation that the company's intended future activities are lawful

registeredEmailAddress.description: Sent only when it has changed

reviewDate.description: The confirmation statement's review date, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future

shareholdings.description: Sent only when Companies House requires it (a new shareholding, or on request)

sicCodes.description: Up to 4 SIC codes; sent only when they have changed

stateConfirmationAccepted.description: The user's confirmation that the information the company must deliver to the registrar is delivered and that the statement is correct as at the confirmation date

statementOfCapital.description: Sent only when the statement of capital has changed

name: render_confirmation_statement_sandbox
title: Render a confirmation statement
